date.source: Posted 8 April 2017 to HEW's own fwrestling.com forum

title: So, I'm Back Up in the Game.
note: Mr. Smooth and Simon scout the abandoned Hardcore City Arena, naming several of the promotion's own past stars and a mysterious, unnamed former star ("HIM") Mr. Smooth refuses to invite back.

date.source: Posted 9 April 2017 to HEW's own fwrestling.com forum

title: Into the Fray
note: A masked Code Name: Reaper announces his entry into HEW's own comeback Barbwire Gauntlet, calling out three named prior stars; no result for the event survives on the record.
